Name: RedRays SAP Security Findings
Author: RedRays, Inc. - support@redrays.io
Description: Bring RedRays SAP security findings into Microsoft Sentinel. Review vulnerability assessments, ABAP code findings, BTP security, segregation of duties, profile parameter checks and password security in one workbook, with analytics rules for findings that need attention. RedRays sends data on a schedule you choose through the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API and stays in your existing on-premises or cloud environment. This connector does not collect SAP Security Audit Log events or populate ABAPAuditLog. You need a RedRays license with Microsoft Sentinel integration. Azure ingestion and retention charges apply.
WorkbookDescription: Review SAP security findings, scan coverage and scheduled export health.
AnalyticalRuleBladeDescription: Choose from seven analytics rule templates. Review your initial findings, then create and enable the rules you need. Installing the solution does not enable any rules.
